labels.name: Junctional nevus
labels.function: Flat and pigmented; nests at the epidermal-dermal junction

labels.name: Compound nevus
labels.function: Raised and pigmented; nests at junction plus dermis

labels.name: Intradermal nevus
labels.function: Raised but not pigmented; nests in the dermis only

labels.name: Seborrheic keratosis
labels.function: Waxy, rough, stuck-on growth of epidermal keratinocytes

labels.name: Acrochordon
labels.function: Pedunculated normal skin; more common with obesity and diabetes

labels.name: Dermatofibroma
labels.function: Fibroblast and histiocyte proliferation; dimples when pinched

labels.name: Epidermal inclusion cyst
labels.function: Keratin-filled sac with a central punctum; sterile if it ruptures

labels.name: Lipoma
labels.function: Soft, compressible, encapsulated benign tumor of fat

labels.name: Pilar cyst
labels.function: Familial scalp cyst with no punctum; rarely ruptures

labels.name: Sebaceous hyperplasia
labels.function: Yellow umbilicated papules of the forehead and cheeks in midlife

labels.name: Keloid
labels.function: Scar growing beyond the wound; TGF-beta-1 driven, recurs

labels.name: Milia
labels.function: 1-2 mm white keratinous cysts, most often in adult women

labels.name: Hidrocystoma
labels.function: Clear fluid-filled sweat gland cyst; drain and remove lining

labels.name: Accessory nipple
labels.function: Extra nipple on the embryonic milk line, often mistaken for a mole

labels.name: Cherry angioma
labels.function: Red dome-shaped vascular tumors that multiply with age

labels.name: Cafe-au-lait macule
labels.function: Congenital fixed melanin increase; six or more suggest NF

labels.name: Digital mucous cyst
labels.function: Joint fluid from DIP osteoarthritis pressing on the nail matrix
